summary_of_core_decisions: The text ultimately leaves the tension unresolved, suggesting that neither Hegel's totalizing system nor Starrett's dialogical reinterpretation fully resolves the exclusion of the feminine. It concludes with the enduring 'ghost of Antigone' as a reminder of the cost of universal reason.

thesis_commitment.conclusion_type: Qualified - the text does not fully endorse either Oliver's rejection or Starrett's defense, but highlights the unresolved dilemma
